newsitem.title: QATAR: Korea Gas Corp uses option to buy more Qatar LNG.
newsitem.headline: Korea Gas Corp uses option to buy more Qatar LNG.

text.p: Korea Gas Corporation of South Korea has exercised an option to buy an additional 2.4 million tonnes of gas annually from Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG Company (Rasgas) in return for a five percent stake in the company's equity, Rasgas announced on Wednesday.

"It (Rasgas) has reached agreement in principle to increase its sales of liquefied natural gas to Korea Gas Corporation (Kogas) from 2.4 million metric tonnes per annum under an existing sales and purchase agreement to 4.8 million tonnes per annum", said a press release issued by the company.
